message: Vector Rebel 3.2.70: mark past Captain tours OFF for a firefighter when not assigned either day, with a clearly labeled manual reason and no false missing PPE checks.
releaseNotes: Daily Captain Check 3.2.70 adds historical tour attendance exceptions: from Results click Edit Past OFF or an overdue red X, select a firefighter and a fully completed two-day tour, provide the reason and explicitly confirm that person worked neither shift. Their PPE items for that tour display OFF* and do not count as missed. OFF* is labeled as captain-entered, never as a completed Vector check or a verified CrewSense absence. Previously completed native inspection records remain visible as green where applicable. A Restore Requirement action removes an incorrect manual exception, and all changes immediately recalculate the existing read-only report without claiming a new scan or recheck. Historical edits persist locally in a separate versioned ledger and are included in script-owned local storage and private portable backups; they do not modify the master roster, Captain Sets, actual Vector inspections or CrewSense. Prior Day 1/Day 2 swing choices, targeted Recheck Missing and all SCBA submission protections are preserved. The completed-tour guard prevents preemptively excusing active shifts.
